**VCS adapter PR6 done — all 6 slices complete (PR #9)**

What: PR6 (final slice) done — bootstrap.sh + install-tools.sh provider-agnostic. PR #9 open → tracker. ALL 6 VCS adapter slices implemented.

PR6 key points:
- providers authLogin: token optional, reads .env via vcsToken(PROVIDER) → shell auths without token in argv.
- cli.mjs: boolean verb false → exit 1 (shell exit-code branching for auth-check/auth-login).
- bootstrap.sh: identity via node (config→origin fallback) read with mapfile (no eval); per-provider credential helper username (oauth2/x-access-token) + token var; PAT URL via patSetupUrl; auth via dispatcher; ticket list via tracker-board.mjs.
- install-tools.sh: gh/glab per provider, gh apt-then-docs fallback.
- harness-contract.md genericized.
- Security review: token never in argv; credential helper reads .env at use, never stored. 0 blockers.

FULL CHAIN STATE (epic #2):
- tracker feature/issue-2-vcs-adapter = main + PR1..PR5 (merged GitHub PRs #1,#5,#6,#7,#8).
- PR #9 (PR6) OPEN → tracker.
- After #9 merges: open final PR feature/issue-2-vcs-adapter → main to CLOSE epic #2.

Adapter complete: brain.config.json vcs.provider selects github/gitlab; dispatcher scripts/vcs/cli.mjs; providers + 10 verbs; all callers (day-start, tracker-board, project-status, ticket-start, bootstrap, install-tools) provider-agnostic. Verified e2e against this GitHub repo. 49 tests.

PENDING follow-up slices (NOT the adapter): (1) CLI output i18n with English fallback [[architecture/cli-i18n]]; (2) comments→English sweep for untouched scripts + ADR-0009 codify [[convention/artifact-language]]. Related: [[sdd/vcs-adapter/tasks]].
